node.title: Star node (a placed star)
node.canon: Star Magic overview: 'create and manipulate stars at will' (EN wiki, Star Magic)
node.note: Stardust Field step (field: from the ground point to +1 up, power r/3); there is no placed star today

lines.title: Constellation lines (nodes linked)
lines.canon: Star Magic overview: 'connecting stars forms a constellation, stronger attacks and defences' (EN wiki)
lines.note: Constellation page: volley of 5 bolts, 14 ticks, power 0.6 (THREAD_LINE is rewritten to STAR_MAGIC)

conjunction.title: Conjunction (teleport between stars)
conjunction.canon: Star Magic: Conjunction, ch. 309/310: teleport to the point beneath one of your stars (EN wiki; JA 合天)
conjunction.note: Conjunction page: dash 12 blocks ahead, vfx from start+1 to dest+1, 12 ticks, power 1

scutum.title: Quartile Scutum (4-star barrier)
scutum.canon: Star Magic: Quartile Scutum, ch. 309/310: four stars, beams between them form a rectangular barrier (EN wiki; JA 四天・盾)
scutum.note: Star Shield page: empower, sendFollowing with SPIRIT_AURA (not a star effect at all)

hasta.title: Quartile Hasta (spear of light)
hasta.canon: Star Magic: Quartile Hasta (EN wiki nav, no page text; JA 四天・槍: light gathered in the middle of four stars, fired as a laser)
hasta.note: Star Beam page: line 16, vfx eye -> eye+16, 18 ticks, power 1.2

flagellum.title: Quartile Flagellum (whip of light)
flagellum.canon: Star Magic: Quartile Flagellum, ch. 310: starlight joins four stars into a thin sharp whip (EN wiki; JA 四天・鞭)
flagellum.note: Quartile Flagellum page: cone range 8, vfx eye -> eye+8, 14 ticks, power r/4 = 2

halation.title: Halation (beams from the stars)
halation.canon: no canon spell of this name found (EN and JA search); mod-original beam finisher
halation.note: Orbit Barrage page: volley of 5 homing bolts on one target (14 ticks, power 0.6)
